evidence: Live complete-case cell means reproduce the paper's Table 3 (experiment R1, cov_risk_type='Hazard-Identifikation', 107 of 109 respondents complete on all five items) in all 20 cells: F01 6.67/6.52/6.35/6.19 vs published 6.66/6.51/6.34/6.18; F02 5.85/5.93/4.65/4.67 vs 5.85/5.92/4.65/4.66; F03 4.37/3.56/4.85/5.04 vs 4.37/3.55/4.84/5.03; F04 3.56/4.15/3.38/3.78 vs 3.55/4.14/3.38/3.77; F06 2.81/3.63/3.27/2.67 vs 2.81/3.63/3.27/2.67 (max deviation 0.009, the paper truncating to 2dp). All 119 rival permutations of the five codes score max-deviation >=1.108, so every item is distinguished from every other. Direction of resp is pinned by Table 3's caption, 'the higher the scores, the higher the value on the variables', placing each item's low anchor at resp=1. It does NOT establish the German wording of the anchors or of the instructions, which the deposit publishes only in English.

Route 1 (per-item descriptives), run on all 18 items. Paper Table 2 publishes n/Mean/SD per trait; item_stats.R on the live table reproduces every triple exactly, trait by trait: Confidence 228/4.14/0.86, Calmness 228/3.63/1.07, Intelligence 228/4.12/0.83, Trainability 227/3.90/0.88, Boldness 227/3.81/0.95, Patience 227/3.49/0.99, Timidness 228/2.01/0.93, Persistence 228/3.98/0.92, Hyperactivity 228/2.78/1.24, Initiative 226/3.85/0.89, Excitability 227/3.17/1.14, Obedience 228/3.74/0.91, Nervousness 226/1.98/0.95, Impulsiveness 225/2.58/1.13, Sociability 225/4.04/0.98, Friendliness 223/4.33/0.84, Stamina 224/3.99/0.83, Overall ability 184/3.85/0.84 - 18/18 agree to the published 2 d.p. with max |diff| = 0.00. Every item is separated from every other by the (n, mean, SD) triple: the only mean ties are Initiative 3.85 vs Overall_ability 3.85 (n 226 vs 184, SD 0.89 vs 0.84) and Persistence 3.98 vs Stamina 3.99 (n 228 vs 224, SD 0.92 vs 0.83), both resolved. The same numbers fix the resp direction, which is the option_text axis: a reversed 1-5 coding would put Nervousness at 6-1.98=4.02 and Confidence at 1.86, so 1='very low' and 5='very high' as the paper states. What this does NOT establish: the three interior anchors low/average/high are checked only as an ordered sequence between the verified endpoints, not individually, and it says nothing about which SECTION an item sat in (Stamina's with-stock placement rests on S1 image7 plus the paper's sentence, not on these numbers).
